title: Belrose Circle Membership Programme Register of Grounds on which Points Fall Away and Lapse for Inactivity
content:
# Belrose Circle Membership Programme — Register of Grounds on which Points Fall Away, and Lapse for Inactivity

Points held under the Belrose Circle Membership Programme fall away on a closed set of grounds, and a membership without qualifying spend for the tier's inactivity period lapses. The expiry period, the inactivity period, whether unspent points are swept at the year end and whether they are forfeited on closure are each fixed by the member's tier.

## Rule

Unspent points fall away after the tier's expiry period, counted from the month they were earned, and the tier that never expires points is the only one they do not fall away on. Points fall away only while the membership stands at active, review pending, lapsed or closed, and the reason is recorded as one of the closed set of grounds. A membership that goes the tier's inactivity period without qualifying spend lapses, and the points on it fall away under the inactivity ground. On closure the points fall away at the tiers that forfeit them and are preserved for the period the programme allows at the tiers that do not. Points that have fallen away are not reinstated, because the period they were held for was published to the member when they were earned.

## Register of grounds

| Ground recorded | When points fall away on this ground |
|---|---|
| inactivity | the membership has gone the tier's inactivity period without qualifying spend and lapses; the points on it fall away |
| annual sweep | unspent points are swept at the end of a membership year, at a tier that sweeps them |
| membership closed | the membership closes, at a tier that forfeits unspent points on closure |

Each block of points falling away for one reason is recorded as one entry, carrying the date the points fell away, the points as a negative figure, the ground, and the accounting period the entry is accounted to.

## Status at which points fall away

| Status recorded on the membership | Points may fall away |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| review pending | yes |
| lapsed | yes |
| closed | yes |
| suspended | no |
| enrolled | no |

The status is read from the membership record held by the company, against the membership number, before the entry is booked.

## Inactivity

The period without qualifying spend is measured in whole calendar months elapsed from the most recent earning entry on the membership to the day of handling, with no upper bound. A membership whose count reaches the tier's inactivity period lapses, and moves from active to lapsed. A lapsed membership that has sat unreclaimed past the review period is closed.

### Reading the count (hypothetical)

Assume a tier whose inactivity period is 24 whole months. A membership whose most recent earning entry was booked 23 whole months before the day of handling has not gone the inactivity period; a membership whose most recent earning entry was booked 24 whole months before it has, and it lapses, its points falling away under the inactivity ground.

## Reinstatement

Points that have fallen away are not reinstated on any ground, whether they fell away for inactivity, on a sweep or on closure.
